task_description: Fix a confirmed live defect where identity/customer.py::normalize_phone silently rewrites an explicitly-entered foreign phone number into an Indian one (+6591234567 -> +916591234567), by adding a strict additive normaliser that preserves an explicit country code and wiring it at the customer-facing phone entry points only. Plus two hardening items: Cache-Control: no-store on session/auth responses that carry a CSRF or session-bound value, and an owner-approval report on the shared-role IAM over-grant on the customer-session authorisation table. Source + tests + one dated doc only; no deploy.
